description: Land Acquisition - Nillakkegama, Polgahawela D/S Division,  Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that 81 allotments of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides extensive details about land parcels, including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, boundaries, and claimed ownership. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
